name: Cyber Conversion — the picked target is turned face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature, and a new pick turns it back
notes: Conor's decision 2026-11-19: a fired spell or ability that turns a target face down or face up does it once the target is picked, as attaching does (_applyFiredFace in cards-battlefield.js; the parser's _faceMarker effects only give the picker). Cyber Conversion's "It's a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature" is its face-down characteristics (CR 708.2a, faceDownAs), no longer a layer-4 type change and a layer-7b P/T setting on a face-up creature. Grizzly Bears was picked first, then Hill Giant: the Bears is turned back face up with its +1/+1 counter (setFaceDown used to drop a permanent's counters both ways), and the Giant is a face-down 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature with no colour or abilities.
